Unchecked addition in AmberToken.mint: balance += _value, totalSupply += _value
Unchecked additions/division in AmberToken.mintLocked: tokensPerPhase += _value / UNLOCK_PHASES, totalSupply += _value
Unchecked multiplication and addition in AmberToken.unlockTokens: tokens * (phase - nextPhase), balance += ...
Unchecked subtraction and addition in AmberToken.transfer: balance -= _value, balance += _value
Unchecked subtraction and addition in AmberToken.transferFrom: allowanceOf -= _value, balance -= _value, balance += _value
Unchecked additions in AmbrosusSale.notePrepurchase: saleRevenue += _etherPaid, totalSold += _amberSold
Unchecked multiplication and additions in specialPurchase: buyinReturn * msg.value, saleRevenue += msg.value, totalSold += bought
Unchecked multiplication and additions in processPurchase: msg.value * STANDARD_BUYIN, saleRevenue += msg.value, totalSold += ...
Unchecked multiplication/division in initialiseAllocations: LIQUID_ALLOCATION_PPM * totalSold / SALES_ALLOCATION_PPM, etc.
Unchecked subtraction/division in currentPhase: (now - phaseStart) / PHASE_DURATION
